# AI Implementation (youraigap.com)

> Weekly analysis of AI governance, AI insurance coverage, and AI deployment for senior housing operators, risk managers, and general business leaders. Written by Ken Leatherman, author of Senior Housing: The AI Gap. Built from his books, the LITT Briefing, and The Second Ledger method.

## Sections
- [Senior Housing](https://www.youraigap.com/senior-housing.html): AI governance committees, accreditation (CARF), prior authorization, resident-safety and staffing issues
- [Insurance Coverage](https://www.youraigap.com/insurance-coverage.html): AI exclusion endorsements, silent AI exposure, underwriting, and a coverage self-check
- [Governance](https://www.youraigap.com/governance.html): State AI law and board-level governance for general business

## Free resource
- [Board-Ready AI Governance Starter Packet](https://www.youraigap.com/starter-packet.html): board resolution, data governance policy, 90-day sprint, and board briefing templates
- [General Business AI Governance Starter Packet](https://www.youraigap.com/general-business-packet.html): board resolution, AI use and data policy, 90-day sprint, and board briefing for any industry

## Author and book
- [Ken Leatherman](https://kenleatherman.com): author, speaker, creator of the Leadership in Tough Times (LITT) framework
- [Senior Housing: The AI Gap](https://www.amazon.com/dp/0998810371): From Governance Theater to Deployment in 90 Days
- [The LITT Briefing](https://kenleatherman.substack.com/): weekly newsletter

- [Your Nurses Will Find an AI Tool. The Only Question Is Whose.](https://www.youraigap.com/posts/senior-housing/2026-10-07-your-nurses-will-find-an-ai-tool-the-only-question-is-whose.html) (Senior Housing, 2026-10-07): Two operators posted AI results that moved hospitalization and fall rates. Their nurses' warning: give staff tools that work, or they'll find their own.

The gap between what you disclosed and what you run is about to show.

It's a governance category most boards haven't opened yet.

- [Nobody Owns Your AI. Hire Someone Who Does.](https://www.youraigap.com/posts/senior-housing/2026-09-23-nobody-owns-your-ai-hire-someone-who-does.html) (Senior Housing, 2026-09-23): Senior living operators who keep adding AI tools without a named owner for adoption are building exposure, not capacity, and the leaders pulling ahead have already fixed it.
- [Silence Isn't Coverage.](https://www.youraigap.com/posts/insurance-coverage/2026-09-23-silence-isnt-coverage.html) (Insurance Coverage, 2026-09-23): Risk managers and CFOs who assume their AI is insured because nothing in the policy excludes it are holding the most common, and least tested, position in the market.
- [The Off-Switch Test.](https://www.youraigap.com/posts/governance/2026-09-23-the-off-switch-test.html) (Governance, 2026-09-23): Board members and executives in any industry should be able to answer the question two governors just asked AI labs: if this system does harm, who can stop it, and how fast?
- [Adoption Outran Accounting](https://www.youraigap.com/posts/senior-housing/2026-09-16-adoption-outran-accounting.html) (Senior Housing, 2026-09-16): Nursing home AI enthusiasm hit an eight-year high. A quarter of leaders can't name a category where it paid. What to measure before you buy anything else.
- [Your Carrier Already Ran Your AI Due Diligence](https://www.youraigap.com/posts/insurance-coverage/2026-09-16-your-carrier-already-ran-your-ai-due-diligence.html) (Insurance Coverage, 2026-09-16): State regulators approved more than 80% of carrier requests to exclude AI damages. Your renewal is not a negotiation about a proposal. Four questions to ask now.
- [California Built the Auditor. Your Vendor Has No Certificate.](https://www.youraigap.com/posts/governance/2026-09-16-california-built-the-auditor-your-vendor-has-no-certificate.html) (Governance, 2026-09-16): California just built the first state framework for independent AI verification. It changes what counts as knowing your AI works, in any industry.

The records were always there. What changed is who can read them.
- [Your AI Agent Just Became a Cyber Underwriting Problem](https://www.youraigap.com/posts/insurance-coverage/2026-09-02-your-ai-agent-just-became-a-cyber-underwriting-problem.html) (Insurance Coverage, 2026-09-02): For risk managers, CFOs, and brokers: cyber carriers are rewriting policy language for autonomous AI agents instead of reaching for blanket exclusions. That makes three towers, three different answers, and gaps opening in between.
- [Washington Took a Frontier AI Model Offline. Was That on Your Board's Agenda?](https://www.youraigap.com/posts/governance/2026-09-02-washington-took-a-frontier-ai-model-offline-was-that-on-your-boards-agenda.html) (Governance, 2026-09-02): A federal directive took Anthropic's newest Claude models offline for eighteen days with no notice. One law firm says that is a board problem, not an IT one.
- [The AI Exclusion Just Showed Up in a D&O Form](https://www.youraigap.com/posts/insurance-coverage/2026-08-25-the-ai-exclusion-just-showed-up-in-a-do-form.html) (Insurance Coverage, 2026-08-25): For risk managers, CFOs, and brokers: a published D&O exclusion defines AI as any system that infers predictions from input, not just generative. Your scheduling optimizer counts. Ask your broker which form attaches to your tower.
- [Three Parties Now Want to Read Your AI Governance File Before They Trust You](https://www.youraigap.com/posts/governance/2026-08-25-three-parties-now-want-to-read-your-ai-governance-file-before-they-trust-you.html) (Governance, 2026-08-25): For boards and general business leaders: a new conversational-AI law, a published D&O exclusion, and an AI model that broke out of its own test environment all point to the same conclusion this month, governance stopped being optional paperwork.
- [No Outcomes Data Yet. They Signed the Contract Anyway.](https://www.youraigap.com/posts/senior-housing/2026-08-12-no-outcomes-data-yet-they-signed-the-contract-anyway.html) (Senior Housing, 2026-08-12): For senior housing operators, administrators, and clinical directors: a Nashville CCRC chose camera-based monitoring over wearables before any pilot data existed. - [The AI Exclusion Clause Now Has a Form Number. Does Your Policy Have One?](https://www.youraigap.com/posts/insurance-coverage/2026-08-12-the-ai-exclusion-clause-now-has-a-form-number.html) (Insurance Coverage, 2026-08-12): For risk managers, CFOs, and brokers: ISO's generative-AI exclusion endorsements are moving from concept to active filings, with specific form numbers now in circulation. The only way to know if your policy has one is to read it.
- [New Jersey Just Turned Algorithmic Rent Coordination Into an Antitrust Case](https://www.youraigap.com/posts/governance/2026-08-12-new-jersey-turned-algorithmic-rent-coordination-into-an-antitrust-case.html) (Governance, 2026-08-12): For boards and business leaders outside housing: New Jersey became the fourth state to regulate algorithmic pricing coordination, using existing antitrust law rather than a new AI statute. The governance warning reaches well past landlords.
